lines.en: I am short, and my steps are quick.
My golden hair lifts in the wind.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，脚几乎不点地
lines.en: I run, my feet barely touching down.

lines.zh: 矮我一头的墙，我一跃就过
lines.en: Walls a head taller are one hop away.
Ki carries me, skimming the ground.
These boots are new and still stiff.
I round the rocks without slowing.
This jacket is a bit too big.

lines.zh: 脚步轻，是变身后的好处
lines.en: Light feet are the upside of this form.

lines.zh: 我抬头看比自己高的树
lines.en: I look up at trees taller than me.
I stop and look back for you.
Golden ki circles my shoulder.
I cannot sit still; too wound up.
Being short, I see low things.

lines.zh: 我学着父亲的样子站着
lines.en: I stand the way my father stood.
The wind makes me squint.
I am thinking of what my mother said.
My aura is small but hot.
I flick the gold hair off my brow.

lines.zh: 这地方高得让人不习惯
lines.en: The sky here feels too high.
I huff to push down the nerves.
My legs are still growing; the power came first.
I damp the aura to save it.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处，学着不眨眼
lines.en: I stare into the distance, practicing not blinking.
I look up at you; you are taller.
I do not like being looked down on.
Gold hair blocks my eye; I push it aside.
I can feel your ki.
I am not afraid of you.
If you want to fight, I will not dodge.
I fold my arms and act grown up.
I know that kind of weapon.
You look at me like I am a child.
I am not a child. Do not mistake it.
I lift my chin a little.
I smile, then hide it.
If you need directions, ask.
I stand very straight.
Ki flickers on my knuckles.
I do not back off, though you are taller.
Do not pat my head.
I bite down and make no sound.
I can take this much pain.
I back off, guarding my arm.
Blood runs from my nose.
My ki shielded me a little.
I wipe blood from the corner of my mouth.
It hurts, but I stand firm.
I take two hard breaths.
You hit hard.
I can still fight.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我一口就没了
lines.en: That would be gone in one bite.
I do not eat what strangers give.

lines.zh: 我的肚子叫了，你听见了
lines.en: My stomach growled; did you hear it?
Half is fine; the rest is yours.
Mother said not to be greedy.
I take it and tuck it away.
Can I take this with me?
Do you have more?
I bite it and my eyes light up.
You need a full stomach for strength.
I am small; I cannot hurt you.
I give a step and steady myself.
That nearly knocked me over.
I grab your sleeve.
Do not push me; I can walk.
We clang together.

lines.zh: 矮有矮的好处，撞不着头
lines.en: Being short has perks; no head bumps.
I go around you and keep walking.
Dust makes me cough.
I am young; not this.

lines.zh: 比我高的女生，我也不怕
lines.en: Taller girls do not scare me either.
Such things can wait.
I do not understand, and I will not pretend.

lines.zh: 同伴就好，别的要求没有
lines.en: Just be my comrade; nothing more.
I do not want to burden anyone.
Let us walk a stretch side by side.
My ears feel warm under the gold hair.
Do not ask; I have not decided.
I stoop and pick it up quickly.
This thing is quite heavy.
It fell in the mud; let me wipe it.
I stuff it in my pocket.
That is mine; I can use it.
I hold it up for someone to see.
So small I nearly missed it.
I pick up two; one is for you.

lines.zh: 手里有东西，打起来不方便
lines.en: Holding things makes fighting awkward.
I set it on the rock.

lines.zh: 个子小也有个子小的打法
lines.en: Small has its own way of fighting.
I go first; I will not wait for the grown-ups.
All my ki gathers in my fists.
Your opening is low.
No need to draw my sword — ki blasts will do.
No battle cries; I just come.
This time I hold nothing back.
Your ki is not steady.
I slip under your guard.
Do not think a child is easy prey.
I have your knees in mind.
Hands first, then the face.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口气，气势上来
lines.en: One breath, and my courage rises.
You are taller, so you must look down.
I am not retreating.
Hit me once; I answer three times.
Close in; leave you no gap.
Small ki blasts form fast in my hand.
I jump to reach your shoulder.
Small and quick to dodge.
I wait for your hand to rise.
I follow your footwork.
I come out of your shadow.
Do not back off; if you do, I chase.
I have been practicing this move.
Your ki is trembling.
Again; I am not tired yet.
I gather ki under my soles.
One step is enough to close in.

lines.zh: 我看见你的手在出口袋
lines.en: I see your hand leaving your pocket.
I will not let you turn around.
A small fist drives in.
My punch lands at your waist.
Short legs, but the kick is exact.
Two quick blows, then I break off.
I use your arm to swing up.
That one carried real ki.
You duck, so I strike the face.
A knife-hand chops your bracer.
I land and come right back.
A ki blast bursts at close range.
Do not underestimate this fist.
I kick the back of your knee.
A shoulder check into you.
That one jarred my own hand.
I shout as I strike.
The last one takes everything.
I drop from midair and land.

lines.zh: 金气把地面照亮一小块
lines.en: My aura lights a patch of ground.
Everything here is too tall.
First I check for anyone around.
Short, so my view is low.
I slap the dirt off my trousers.
I hear thunder far off.
It was not my idea to come.
My boot sinks; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 我把拳头举到眼前看了看
lines.en: I hold my fist up and look at it.
The glow on my hair has not faded.
One breath, and I steady.
Nobody here knows me.
I count the people nearby.
The wind slants my aura.
I stand and wait for someone to speak.
My palms are sweating.

lines.zh: 我又一次被丢到陌生的地方
lines.en: Dropped somewhere strange again.
Fire crawls up my sleeve.
My legs land first, numb with pain.
Being short, the water reaches my neck.
The blast rolls me far.
That force seeps into my bones.
Hunger makes my sight swim.

lines.zh: 雷打在金气上，全身一麻
lines.en: Lightning meets my aura and numbs me.
No ground beneath; nothing to grip.
